decision.comment: Ingestion stage is clean and internally consistent. All deterministic checks pass: archive MD5/SHA256 verified against the Zenodo source, loaded split sizes (89996/10004/7180) exactly match the official PathMNIST split sizes with no subsampling, 9-class multi-label schema is coherent, and 3-channel RGB is consistent with the standard 28×28 MedMNIST distribution. Deterministic findings list is empty. Two observations for downstream stages: (1) The test-domain note confirms the 7,180 test images originate from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K), so test AUROC will reflect cross-domain generalization rather than in-distribution accuracy—this is a valid design choice but must be carried into any OOD-aggregate reporting (arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not pooled-sample AUROC). (2) llm_model_digest is null for the auxiliary qwen3.8 Ollama component; this does not affect the core CNN training path but slightly weakens full end-to-end reproducibility of any LLM-assisted analysis. Neither observation is a blocking issue. Proceed to the next stage.
